record.label: N1.2g THE COMPRESSION: endpoint adjoint reads (C1, 08-31) — ~10-150 scalars/layer carry the whole third-order effect
record.summary: S = sum_l <dK21_l, M_l> with closed-form t0 adjoint M_l = diag(a2_l)[sum_{L>l} B_{l->L} diag(S_v g_L) B_{l->L}^T] diag(e1_l); sanity 15.7% linear capture; value-rank r95 per layer L7 104, L8 135, L10 45, L11 14, L12 93, L13 11, L14 8 (L9 >200). Shelved 08-31 because the reads seemed to need the tensor (C3 randomized-read FAIL). Re-found 2026-09-01 (T-21). The DIRECT emission-delta supply for the reads is dead (T-28: engine and card emissions agree to 1e-5); the reads must be fed by the carried residual (N1.2b) — the adjoint remains the cheapest way to CONSUME whatever carrier wins. T-43: the linear consumption frame is retired for value; the adjoint compression remains a cheap SCREEN for candidate supplies, not the deploy path.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when a deployable carrier's reads reproduce the dense <E_l, M_l> value per layer on r35 and r100.
record.goal_path_summary: The whole third-order effect on the answer is about a thousand numbers with a known formula for the weights; what remains is producing those numbers cheaply.
